subtasks.title: Configure TypeScript compilation settings
subtasks.description: Create and configure tsconfig.json files for backend, frontend, and shared code with appropriate compiler options
subtasks.details:
Create root tsconfig.base.json with shared compiler options: target ES2020, module commonjs/ESNext, strict mode enabled, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck. Create backend/tsconfig.json extending base with: outDir './dist', rootDir './src', module 'commonjs', types for node. Create frontend/tsconfig.json extending base with: module 'ESNext', moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'preserve', DOM lib, decorators enabled for Lit. Create shared/tsconfig.json for common interfaces with declaration files output. Configure path mappings for '@shared/*' imports.
<info added on 2025-08-15T15:30:27.971Z>
All TypeScript configuration files must be created within the js/ directory structure. The root tsconfig.base.json should be placed at js/tsconfig.base.json. Backend configuration goes in js/backend/tsconfig.json, frontend configuration in js/frontend/tsconfig.json, and shared configuration in js/shared/tsconfig.json. Path mappings should be adjusted to reflect the js/ directory structure with '@shared/*' pointing to 'js/shared/*'.
</info added on 2025-08-15T15:30:27.971Z>
<info added on 2025-08-15T16:35:22.234Z>
Implementation completed. All TypeScript configuration files successfully created at correct locations: js/tsconfig.base.json (base configuration), js/backend/tsconfig.json (server settings), js/frontend/tsconfig.json (Lit/Vite settings), js/shared/tsconfig.json (shared types). TypeScript compilation verified working across all modules. Path mapping for '@shared/*' imports configured and tested successfully for cross-module type sharing.

subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for export service interfaces and configuration validation

subtasks.title: Implement Session Export Formats
subtasks.description: Add support for exporting sessions in HTML, JSON, and PDF formats
subtasks.details: Implement HTMLExporter for styled session output, JSONExporter for structured data export, PDFExporter using libraries like jsPDF or Puppeteer, handle large session data efficiently during export
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each export format with various session sizes, verify exported content accuracy and formatting

subtasks.title: Create Backend Performance Utilities
subtasks.description: Implement performance optimization utilities in backend
subtasks.details: Create js/backend/src/utils/performance/ directory with compression utilities for session data, caching mechanisms for frequently accessed sessions, database query optimization helpers, memory usage monitoring tools
subtasks.testStrategy: Performance benchmarks for compression algorithms, cache hit rate testing, memory usage validation

subtasks.title: Create Frontend Performance Utilities
subtasks.description: Implement client-side performance optimization utilities
subtasks.details: Create js/frontend/src/utils/performance/ directory with lazy loading utilities using Intersection Observer API, virtualization helpers for large lists, bundle size monitoring tools, performance metrics collection
subtasks.testStrategy: Test lazy loading with large datasets, validate virtualization performance improvements, measure bundle size impact

subtasks.title: Implement Service Worker for Offline Support
subtasks.description: Add progressive web app features and offline functionality
subtasks.details: Create service worker for caching session data, implement offline detection and queue management, add PWA manifest and installation prompts, handle cache invalidation strategies
subtasks.testStrategy: Test offline functionality, verify cache strategies work correctly, validate PWA installation flow

subtasks.title: Add Bundle Optimization and Code Splitting
subtasks.description: Optimize Vite build configuration for better performance
subtasks.details: Configure Vite for code splitting by routes and components, implement tree shaking for unused code removal, add bundle analysis tools, optimize chunk loading strategies
subtasks.testStrategy: Measure bundle size before and after optimizations, test code splitting in production builds, validate tree shaking effectiveness

subtasks.title: Implement Pagination and Infinite Scrolling
subtasks.description: Add efficient data loading patterns for large session lists
subtasks.details: Implement virtual scrolling for session lists, add pagination controls with configurable page sizes, create infinite scroll with intersection observer, optimize data fetching strategies
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with large datasets (1000+ sessions), measure scroll performance, validate pagination accuracy

subtasks.title: Add Performance Monitoring and Analytics
subtasks.description: Implement performance tracking and reporting
subtasks.details: Add performance metrics collection (Core Web Vitals), implement error tracking and reporting, create performance dashboard for monitoring, add user analytics for usage patterns
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify metrics collection accuracy, test error reporting functionality, validate analytics data integrity
